title: Payy — fintech brand identity film

secondary_motion: no overshoot measured; smear/motion blur on the logo build and glitch distortion on type, no springs or idle loops
color: restricted palette: black, white/grey and acid lime, with a violet photo accent
typography: big bold condensed statements, giant 'PRIVATE' wiping behind a flying card, glitch-distorted letters, distorted display wordmark
shape_language: precise UI pills/cards and cards in 3D, plus an organic scribble/smear logo build
character_humor: no characters or humor (a hand holding a phone, a badge photo)

signature: Black and acid-lime fintech identity: a scribbled smear resolves into the app icon, which shrinks into the UI; pills morph into cards, giant type wipes behind a flying card, and the identity closes on a run of page-peel transitions.

music.summary: 143.6 BPM low-percussion track (pulse 0.40) that kicks in at ~3.3 s, one beat after the logo icon lands; overall cuts on beat = chance (33%), though several mid-film scene changes sit within ±0.15 beat; the music fades from ~29 s under the page-peel montage and the end card plays over silence.

family_note: Elegant core (restricted palette, product UI, clean ease-outs, no springs, one statement at a time) pushed toward Playful by bold type moments, glitch letters and a fast page-peel montage. Mid energy 5.0. Proposed sub-style 'Bold tech brand'; could also be read as a bridge between Editorial and Playful reel.

behaviors.mechanism: lime app-icon square arrives oversized (fills most of the frame) and shrinks toward icon size with a fast start and long deceleration
behaviors.notes: Width 1251→745 px, f176–f210 @60 (2.93–3.50 s), rmse 0.001. Not a pop: no overshoot. Closest token Settle but the tail is nearly linear.

behaviors.mechanism: icon shrinks further while sliding left to become the avatar of a UI list row ('Private Money / For a public world')
behaviors.notes: Width 745→391 px f210–f234 @60 (Cruise 0.05); center-x 952→565 px in 283 ms, bezier (0.675,0.102,0.404,0.682) ~Flat 0.114. Element changes role instead of exiting (Elegant rule 8).

behaviors.mechanism: thin line curves drift on black, cut to a heavy motion-smeared black mark on grey, which resolves into a scribbled outline, then lime fill, then hard cut to the solid lime icon
behaviors.notes: 2.47–3.40 s, read from sheet a (states change every ~4–8 f @60). A 'construction → solid' variant (cross-family pattern).

behaviors.mechanism: WALLET / ACTIVITY / MENU nav pills slide in from the right, the row slides left and the pills merge into a single large MENU pill; later two pills stretch into the phone-UI card
behaviors.notes: 5.0–6.5 s and 11.1–11.5 s, read from sheets b and c.

behaviors.mechanism: bold condensed 'PRIVATE TRANSACTIONS' in lime holds, then a lime scribble/logo shape passes through and displaces/slices the letters (glitch)
behaviors.notes: 8.1–9.1 s, read from sheet b. Type enters as 'PRIVATE' then the second line (7.3–7.4 s).

behaviors.mechanism: app icon on a phone home screen fills from dark through an orange gradient to lime
a lime card flips and flies across the frame; giant black 'PRIVATE' slides horizontally behind it, revealed inside a white band
brand-identity applications (logo plate, app UI, type specimen, badge, social posts, poster) change by page-curl peels, one after another
behaviors.notes: 29.8–32.2 s, ~7 peels in 2.4 s (~0.3–0.4 s each), read from sheet f. Plays over the music fade-out.

behaviors.mechanism: quiet 3 s intro; the logo resolves to the solid icon at 2.93 s and the full track kicks in on the next beat (~3.34 s)
behaviors.notes: RMS 0.03 (0–3 s) → 0.13–0.17 (3–28 s). Icon solid −0.99 beat from the first tracked beat. Music-sync behavior.

behaviors.mechanism: music fades from ~29 s; 'Private By Default' and a small grey logo fade in/out over silence, then ~4 s of black
behaviors.notes: RMS 0.08 at 29 s → 0.004 at 34 s → 0 after 35 s (measured); fades read from sheet f.
